justification: Adds one allowed verdict and makes the repair keep it; served links for three rows change from page 1 to their read page.

pre_impl.existing_data: regulatory_provisions.page_check with the 079 CHECK constraint and the 079 triggers that clear verdicts on text, page or PDF change.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If a person marks the wrong page, the mark stands until the text, page or PDF changes; the mark is set only by a reviewed script.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Migration 080 marks the three reviewed rows itself, only while each is still on the page that was read.

functions.name: judge_pdf
functions.input: one chapter PDF path and its served rows including page_check and page_source_path
functions.output: planned verdict rows written back by write()
functions.if_none: rows without the mark are judged by the locator as before

values.if_missing: NULL is judged by the locator as before

break_it.scenario: A person's mark outlives a changed rule text
break_it.what_happens: the link points at a page that no longer holds the new text
break_it.how: migrations/079_rule_page_check.sql trigger clears page_check when text, page or chapter changes
break_it.repro: scratch Postgres: update provision_text, page_check becomes NULL

break_it.scenario: A person's mark outlives a new council PDF
break_it.what_happens: the link points at a page of a superseded PDF
break_it.how: scripts/dcp_page_repair.py:156 keeps the mark only while page_source_path equals the current PDF; the 079 registry trigger also clears it

break_it.scenario: The repair re-judges a marked row and downgrades it to unresolved
break_it.what_happens: a read page link reverts to page 1
break_it.how: scripts/dcp_page_repair.py:156 returns the mark before calling the locator

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the repair stops keeping read_by_person, or the site stops linking it
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 2026-09-27: before this change the three rows were written with page_check unresolved and the site opened their PDF at page 1; scratch Postgres refused a bogus value and cleared the mark on a text edit.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: apply migrations/080_page_read_by_person.sql. It adds the value AND marks the three read rows in the same migration (guarded on their page), so nothing outside the repository is needed.
